zh_CN: 你打铁的样子真帅。
en: You look great at the anvil.

zh_CN: 最近生意怎么样？
en: How is business lately?

zh_CN: 我嘴笨，敲铁比说话利索。
en: I am clumsy with words but handy with a hammer.

zh_CN: 可这句我练了很久——我喜欢你。
en: But I practiced this one. I like you.

zh_CN: 谢谢你。
en: Thank you.

zh_CN: 生意忙吗？
en: Busy these days?

zh_CN: 秋收要用的镰刀，我给你留着最好的。
en: I saved the best sickle for your harvest.

zh_CN: 客气啥，拿去用。
en: Don't mention it. Take it.

zh_CN: 秋收前都这样，忙点好。
en: Always like this before harvest. Busy is good.

zh_CN: 少、少贫嘴！……不过，谢了。
en: Quit it! ...Thanks, though.

zh_CN: 你这家伙结实，来，给你打的东西刚出炉。
en: You are a sturdy sort. Your order is fresh from the forge.

zh_CN: 炉子正旺，要打把新家伙吗？
en: The forge is hot. Need a new tool?

zh_CN: 敲了一整天铁，最想见的还是你。
en: After a day at the anvil you are still who I want to see.

zh_CN: 回来啦？炉火我留着，暖手。
en: Back already? I kept the forge warm for you.

zh_CN: 这……你拿蓝羽毛来做什么？
en: This... why the blue feather?

zh_CN: 好。往后我打的每样东西，都有你一半。
en: Then so be it. Everything I forge is half yours.

zh_CN: 天冷了，铁也硬得快，干活得趁热。
en: Cold mornings make the iron bite faster.

zh_CN: 歇会儿吧，别中暑。
en: Take a break. Don't overheat.

zh_CN: 有新打的工具吗？
en: Got any new tools?

zh_CN: 夏天炉子更烤人，可活儿不能停。
en: The forge burns hotter in summer, but work goes on.

zh_CN: ……你倒是会心疼人。
en: ...You do worry about me.

zh_CN: 刚淬过火，趁手得很。
en: Freshly tempered. They feel good in hand.

zh_CN: 斧头和镐子要常磨，砍树砸石头才不费劲。
en: Keep your axe and pickaxe sharp.

zh_CN: 你的手都裂口子了。
en: Your hands are all cracked.

zh_CN: 冬天还开炉吗？
en: Still firing the forge in winter?

zh_CN: 手冻僵了不好打铁，进来暖暖。
en: Cold hands ruin ironwork. Come warm up.

zh_CN: 老毛病，不碍事。
en: Old habit. Doesn't bother me.

zh_CN: 开，铁不等人。
en: Yes. Iron waits for no one.

zh_CN: 还行，庄稼人趁手就够用了。
en: Steady enough. Folks need what lasts.

zh_CN: 好啊，一起去玩！
en: Sure! Let us go play!

zh_CN: 今天学到了什么？
en: What did you learn today?

zh_CN: 一起踩踩看？
en: Want to stomp some together?

zh_CN: 落叶能做什么？
en: What can you do with leaves?

zh_CN: 秋天的落叶踩起来沙沙响，好玩！
en: Fall leaves go crunch under your feet. Fun!

zh_CN: 好耶！比赛谁响！
en: Yeah! Let's see who's louder!

zh_CN: 我妈妈说能沤成肥料。
en: Mom says they turn into fertilizer.

zh_CN: 你就是新来的农场主吗？
en: Are you the new farmer?

zh_CN: 等会儿一起去广场玩吧！
en: Let's play at the plaza later!

zh_CN: 抓到了吗？
en: Caught any?

zh_CN: 别靠水太近哦。
en: Don't get too close to the water.

zh_CN: 夏天可以去河边抓鱼啦！
en: Summer means catching fish at the river!

zh_CN: 抓到了三条！给你一条！
en: Three! Here, one's for you!

zh_CN: 知道啦，我会小心的。
en: I know. I'll be careful.

zh_CN: 我妈妈说，浇水的时候要轻轻的。
en: My mom says water the crops gently.

zh_CN: 我来帮你。
en: I'll help you.

zh_CN: 小心别冻感冒。
en: Don't catch a cold.

zh_CN: 下雪啦！堆雪人堆雪人！
en: It's snowing! Let's build a snowman!

zh_CN: 太好了，你来堆头！
en: Yay! You do the head!

zh_CN: 我都戴围巾了，不怕！
en: I have my scarf on. No worries!

zh_CN: 快看快看，烟花要开始了！
en: Look, the fireworks are about to start!

zh_CN: 夏天的晚上，就该和大家一起看烟花。
en: Summer nights are for fireworks with friends.

zh_CN: 今年的花祭，来看看婆婆新剪的花吧。
en: Come see my freshly cut flowers for the flower festival.

zh_CN: 花开得这么好，都是托你的福。
en: The flowers bloom like this thanks to you.

zh_CN: 今年的收成不错，大家都能过个好年。
en: A fine harvest this year. We will all be warm.

zh_CN: 这些饭菜都是用你的作物做的，多吃点。
en: Everything here is made from your crops. Eat up.

zh_CN: 新年好！今年也请多关照。
en: Happy new year! Please look after us again.

zh_CN: 广场上摆好了酒，大家就等你来了。
en: The drinks are out on the plaza. Everyone is waiting.

zh_CN: 今晚的星星特别亮，许个愿吧。
en: The stars are bright tonight. Make a wish.

zh_CN: 听说在星夜祭许的愿，一定会实现。
en: They say wishes made at the starry night come true.

zh_CN: 浪大，鱼都往深处躲，篓子还空着。
en: Rough waves. The fish went deep and my basket is empty.

zh_CN: 今天收获如何？
en: A good catch today?

zh_CN: 海上有什么故事吗？
en: Any tales from the sea?

zh_CN: 我在海上漂了半辈子，头回这么想靠岸。
en: I have sailed half my life and never wanted to dock like this.

zh_CN: 你要是不嫌弃，我想把船停在你心里。
en: If you will have me I would anchor my boat in your heart.

zh_CN: 教教我怎么钓。
en: Teach me to fish.

zh_CN: 海上有变化吗？
en: Any change out at sea?

zh_CN: 秋天鱼要囤膘，正是好时候。
en: Fall fish fatten up. Prime season.

zh_CN: 行，明早码头等你。
en: Sure. Meet me at the dock at dawn.

zh_CN: 风转凉了，鱼群也往南走。
en: The wind turns cold and the schools head south.

zh_CN: 今天的浪不大，要不要跟我出海？
en: Calm water today. Want to sail with me?

zh_CN: 海风不小，今天浪有点大。
en: Brisk sea wind. The waves are high today.

zh_CN: 再大的风浪，想到岸上有人等，就不怕了。
en: No matter the storm I am calm knowing you wait ashore.

zh_CN: 回来啦，鱼我收拾好了，你歇着。
en: You are back. The fish is cleaned. Take a rest.

zh_CN: 这蓝羽毛……你从哪儿弄来的？
en: This blue feather... where did you get it?

zh_CN: 我收下了。往后风里雨里，都有我。
en: I accept. Through wind and rain you have me.

zh_CN: 冬天鱼都往深水里躲喽。
en: In winter the fish hide in deep water.

zh_CN: 有一回我见过比船还大的影子，到现在也说不清是啥。
en: Once I saw a shadow bigger than the boat. I still cannot say what it was.

zh_CN: 真厉害！
en: Impressive!

zh_CN: 夏天好钓吗？
en: Good fishing in summer?

zh_CN: 夏天鱼肥，今天网里全是大的。
en: Summer fish are fat. Today's net is full of big ones.

zh_CN: 哈，给你留条最肥的。
en: Ha. I saved you the fattest one.

zh_CN: 日头落山那会儿，鱼口最好。
en: Right at sunset the fish bite best.

zh_CN: 退潮的时候，沙滩上能捡到不少好东西。
en: At low tide the beach gives up its treasures.

zh_CN: 歇着也好。
en: A rest is good too.

zh_CN: 冰面上能钓鱼吗？
en: Can you fish on the ice?

zh_CN: 冬天出不了海，就修修网、补补船。
en: No sailing in winter. I mend nets and patch the boat.

zh_CN: 歇久了手痒，还是想出海。
en: Rest too long and I itch for the sea.

zh_CN: 能，凿个洞，鱼自己就上来了。
en: Yes. Cut a hole and they come to you.

zh_CN: 都种了些什么花？
en: What kinds do you grow?

zh_CN: 这些花真好看。
en: These flowers are lovely.

zh_CN: 花儿谢了就不好看了，常来啊。
en: Come back before they wilt.

zh_CN: 老太婆我看人很准，你是个好孩子。
en: I read people well and you are a good soul.

zh_CN: 要是你不嫌弃……那就一起过日子吧。
en: If you do not mind... let us share our days.

zh_CN: 帮我挑一盆。
en: Pick a pot for me.

zh_CN: 花谢了怎么办？
en: What if the flowers wilt?

zh_CN: 菊花开了，摆一盆在屋里也雅致。
en: The chrysanthemums are out. A pot would grace any room.

zh_CN: 来，这盆最精神。
en: Here. This one's the liveliest.

zh_CN: 剪下来晾干，还能香好久。
en: Dry them and they stay fragrant a long while.

zh_CN: 来，这朵最好看的，算婆婆送你的。
en: Here. The prettiest one is my gift to you.

zh_CN: 来挑几朵花吧，刚剪下来的。
en: Freshly cut flowers for you.

zh_CN: 春天有郁金香，夏天有向日葵，秋天就数菊花最精神。
en: Tulips in spring. Sunflowers in summer. Chrysanthemums rule the fall.

zh_CN: 花开得好，是因为有人在等它开呢。
en: Flowers bloom because someone waits for them.

zh_CN: 家里有你在，比满园的花都热闹。
en: With you at home the whole garden feels warmer.

zh_CN: 嘴真甜！这朵拿着，送人也行。
en: Sweet talker! Take this one and gift it if you like.

zh_CN: 哎呀，这羽毛……你当真？
en: Oh my. This feather... are you sure?

zh_CN: 好，好。往后花园里，多你一个。
en: Wonderful. One more pair of hands in the garden.

zh_CN: 真好看，我要了。
en: They're lovely. I'll take it.

zh_CN: 夏天种什么花好？
en: What blooms best in summer?

zh_CN: 夏天的向日葵开得正好，来一支？
en: The sunflowers are at their best. Take one?

zh_CN: 眼光不错，婆婆给你包上。
en: Good eye. Let me wrap it up.

zh_CN: 向日葵最省心，晒得越足越精神。
en: Sunflowers. The more sun the better.

zh_CN: 野花也能卖钱，采下来别浪费。
en: Wildflowers sell too. Don't waste them.

zh_CN: 那就买一束。
en: Then I'll buy a bunch.

zh_CN: 冬天还有花卖吗？
en: Do you sell flowers in winter?

zh_CN: 天冷了，屋里摆点花，心也暖。
en: Cold days. A little green warms the heart.

zh_CN: 拿着，就算婆婆送你的。
en: Take it, a gift from me.

zh_CN: 温室里养着呢，不怕。
en: Greenhouse-grown. No worries.

zh_CN: 你也听说了？旧书里夹着一张矿道地图，送你了。
en: You heard as well? An old book held a mine map. It is yours now.

zh_CN: 想借一本关于季节的书。
en: I would like a book about the seasons.

zh_CN: 随便看看。
en: Just browsing.

zh_CN: 矿洞的传说，这里有记载吗？
en: Are the mine legends written down here?

zh_CN: 我一直在等一个会认真听我说话的人。
en: I have been waiting for someone who truly listens.

zh_CN: 如果那个人是你……我愿意。
en: And if that someone is you... I would be glad.

zh_CN: 念一句给我听？
en: Read me a line?

zh_CN: 秋天图书馆忙吗？
en: Busy at the library in fall?

zh_CN: 秋天适合读诗，落叶和句子都慢下来了。
en: Fall suits poetry. Leaves and lines both slow down.

zh_CN: 就一句：秋日落在书页上。
en: Just one: Autumn rests on the page.

zh_CN: 学生们回来借书，挺热闹的。
en: Students come back for books. Lively enough.

zh_CN: 你来了。书我帮你留着呢，慢慢看。
en: You came. I saved these books for you.

zh_CN: 欢迎来到图书馆，请保持安静。
en: Welcome to the library. Please be quiet.

zh_CN: 和你一起整理书架的时间，比看书还让我安心。
en: Shelving books with you calms me more than reading.

zh_CN: 回家啦？我炖了汤，就等你呢。
en: Welcome home. The soup is ready for you.

zh_CN: 这……这是给我的吗？
en: Is this... for me?

zh_CN: 我愿意。以后每个故事里，都有你。
en: Yes. Every story from now on will have you in it.

zh_CN: 无论外面什么季节，书里都是安静的。
en: Books stay calm whatever the season.

zh_CN: 推荐一本吧。
en: Recommend me one.

zh_CN: 图书馆夏天凉快吗？
en: Is the library cool in summer?

zh_CN: 夏天的午后，最适合在窗边看一本厚书。
en: A summer afternoon is best for a thick book by the window.

zh_CN: 这本，讲海和远方，你会喜欢。
en: This one, of the sea and far places. You'll like it.

zh_CN: 石墙厚，天然凉快，常有人来躲暑。
en: The stone walls keep it cool. People come to escape the heat.

zh_CN: 想了解季节和作物，来这儿翻翻书准没错。
en: Books here explain seasons and crops.

zh_CN: 那我常来陪你。
en: Then I'll visit often.

zh_CN: 有讲冬天的书吗？
en: Any books about winter?

zh_CN: 冬天就靠着炉子和书过活了。
en: In winter I live by the hearth and my books.

zh_CN: 好。位置我给你留着。
en: Yes. I'll keep your seat.

zh_CN: 有，讲雪和极光的，插图很美。
en: Yes, of snow and auroras. Lovely plates.

zh_CN: 请教一下农场的事。
en: Any advice for the farm?

zh_CN: 村里最近怎么样？
en: How is the village lately?

zh_CN: 我一定到场。
en: I'll be there for sure.

zh_CN: 今年村里收成如何？
en: How did the village fare this year?

zh_CN: 丰收祭快到了，今年你可是主角。
en: The harvest festival is near. You are the star this year.

zh_CN: 好，村里就缺你这样的年轻人。
en: Good. This village needs young blood like you.

zh_CN: 托你的福，比往年都好。
en: Better than ever, thanks to you.

zh_CN: 早啊，年轻人。农场就交给你了。
en: Morning. The farm is in your hands now.

zh_CN: 村里还算安稳。倒是矿洞那边，最近总有人进进出出。
en: All quiet here. Though people keep going in and out of the mine.

zh_CN: 换季的时候，能种的东西就变了。
en: When the season turns so do your crops.

zh_CN: 谢谢提醒。
en: Thanks for the reminder.

zh_CN: 村里夏天有什么安排？
en: Anything planned this summer?

zh_CN: 夏天日头毒，下地记得戴帽子。
en: The summer sun bites. Wear a hat in the fields.

zh_CN: 年轻人肯听劝，我就放心了。
en: It eases my mind when the young listen.

zh_CN: 过些日子有烟花大会，别错过。
en: A fireworks show is coming. Don't miss it.

zh_CN: 别忘了给作物浇水，不然它们会枯掉的。
en: Don't forget to water your crops or they wilt.

zh_CN: 我会小心的。
en: I'll be careful.

zh_CN: 冬天还开村会吗？
en: Any village meetings in winter?

zh_CN: 雪一下，路就不好走了，出门当心。
en: Once it snows the roads get rough. Mind your step.

zh_CN: 嗯，农场有你，我就踏实。
en: Good. The farm is safe in your hands.

zh_CN: 开，等雪停了就在广场。
en: Yes. On the plaza once the snow stops.

zh_CN: 有眼光！今天新到了几样好货。
en: Good eye! We just got some fresh stock.

zh_CN: 只是随便看看。
en: Just looking around.

zh_CN: 想买点东西。
en: I would like to buy something.

zh_CN: 谢谢惠顾，慢走！
en: Thanks for coming!

zh_CN: 南瓜怎么卖？
en: How much for the pumpkins?

zh_CN: 今年收成真好。
en: Great harvest this year.

zh_CN: 新收的南瓜和玉米都上架了，来看看？
en: Fresh pumpkins and corn are in. Want a look?

zh_CN: 算你熟客价，够意思吧。
en: Regular-customer price for you. Fair, right?

zh_CN: 可不是嘛，仓库都堆满了。
en: You bet. The storage is bursting.

zh_CN: 欢迎光临，今天要买点什么吗？
en: Welcome! Buying anything today?

zh_CN: 来一瓶，正好解渴。
en: One bottle, please.

zh_CN: 先看看货架。
en: Let me check the shelves.

zh_CN: 天热，冰镇的汽水要不要来一瓶？
en: Hot day. Want a cold bottle of soda?

zh_CN: 爽快！给你算便宜点。
en: Straight to the point. I'll knock a little off.

zh_CN: 慢慢看，货都在那儿摆着呢。
en: Take your time. It's all on display.

zh_CN: 今天天气不错，地里的活儿会顺利的。
en: Nice weather today. Good for the fields.

zh_CN: 谢谢，正冻得慌。
en: Thanks, I'm freezing.

zh_CN: 冬天还开门吗？
en: Are you open in winter?

zh_CN: 外头冷吧？进来烤烤火再走。
en: Cold out there? Warm up by the fire first.

zh_CN: 热水在那边，自己倒。
en: Hot water's over there. Help yourself.

zh_CN: 开，风雪不误，就等你来。
en: Always. Snow or shine, I'm here for you.

zh_CN: 再往里走有段老矿道，听说埋着会发光的石头。
en: There is an old shaft deeper in. They say glowing stones are buried there.

zh_CN: 矿洞深处有什么？
en: What lies deeper in the mine?

zh_CN: 就是打个招呼。
en: Just saying hello.

zh_CN: 你多穿点。
en: Dress warmly.

zh_CN: 矿洞越深越危险吧？
en: The deeper you go, the worse it gets?

zh_CN: 天冷了，洞里的水汽都结在壁上。
en: It's colder now. Damp clings to the walls.

zh_CN: 知道了，你也是。
en: I will. You too.

zh_CN: 越深越黑，好东西也越多。
en: Darker and richer, both.

zh_CN: 洞里黑，跟紧点别乱跑。
en: It's dark in there. Stay close.

zh_CN: 洞里头不分四季，倒省心。
en: Down here it's the same all year round.

zh_CN: 洞里安全吗？
en: Is it safe down there?

zh_CN: 夏天挖到什么好矿？
en: Found anything good this summer?

zh_CN: 外头再热，洞里也是凉的，正好干活。
en: Hot as it is outside, the mine stays cool.

zh_CN: 跟着灯走，别乱拐就行。
en: Follow the lamps. Don't wander.

zh_CN: 运气好，砸出一小块铜。
en: Lucky day. Chipped out a bit of copper.

zh_CN: 带够镐子再来，石头可不客气。
en: Bring a pickaxe. The rocks won't be kind.

zh_CN: 那倒是意外之喜。
en: A happy surprise.

zh_CN: 冬天矿里有什么特别的？
en: Anything special in winter?

zh_CN: 冬天洞里反而暖，手还不僵。
en: In winter the mine is warmer. Hands don't stiffen.

zh_CN: 要不，跟我下去看看？
en: Want to come down and see?

zh_CN: 雪水渗进来，会结成亮晶晶的晶石。
en: Meltwater seeps in and freezes into bright crystal.

zh_CN: 抱抱！
en: Hug!

zh_CN: 陪我玩一会儿。
en: Play with me for a bit.

zh_CN: 你回来啦！抱抱！
en: You are back! Hug!

zh_CN: 嘿嘿，最喜欢你了！
en: Hehe, I like you best!

zh_CN: 好呀，我们来搭积木！
en: Okay! Let's build blocks!

zh_CN: 你借走的那本书，我最近又翻了一遍。
en: I reread the book you borrowed.

zh_CN: 下次来，我留个靠窗的位置给你。
en: Next time I will save you the window seat.

zh_CN: 我整理书的时候，总想着你会不会喜欢这本。
en: While shelving I keep wondering if you would like this one.

zh_CN: ……你来了的话，图书馆就安静不下来了。
en: ...When you are here the library stops being quiet.

zh_CN: 这束是今早刚剪的，颜色最正。
en: Cut this very morning. Best color of the lot.

zh_CN: 别急着谢，花开着就是要给人看的。
en: No need to thank me. Flowers are meant to be seen.

zh_CN: 跟我来，温室最里头那盆，我养了十几年。
en: Come along. The pot deep in the greenhouse I have kept for years.

zh_CN: 能看看它的人，我一辈子也没几个。
en: Very few people I would show it to.

zh_CN: 天没亮就出海了，给你留了个位置。
en: Out before dawn. Saved you a spot.

zh_CN: 海上日出，看一次少一次，趁今天。
en: Sunrise at sea is rare. Today is a good day.

zh_CN: 有个礁岛，我把船停在那儿的时候，谁都不说话。
en: There is a reef islet where nobody speaks when I moor.

zh_CN: ……我想带你去看一次。
en: ...I want to show it to you.

zh_CN: 喏，顺手打的，别嫌弃。
en: Here. Made it in passing. Don't complain.

zh_CN: ……拿着就拿着，我还要干活。
en: ...Just take it. I have work to do.

zh_CN: 挑铁这事，我想来想去，还是你眼光最准。
en: For picking iron I kept coming back to you.

zh_CN: 往后打什么，我也想听听你的意思。
en: From now on I want your word on what I forge.
